source_identity.qualification: The historical run occurred after this parent and before commit 7d8b77e. Costmap-payload capture code was uncommitted, so the exact source tree is not recoverable.

evidence_boundary: The compact export contains the hash-checked delivered costmap, recorded action result, requested goal, and exact matching Navfn log messages. It excludes simulator geometry, obstacle semantic identity, corrected-goal outcome, and evaluator interpretation.
limitations: This retrospectively selected development run is ineligible for confirmatory evaluation.
The exact dirty source snapshot used for costmap payload capture was not retained.
The retained grid was delivered through the Nav2 costmap service but is not proven to be the exact state consumed by every planner invocation.
No retained-grid connection does not establish global physical infeasibility, a physical berth-width restriction, or a unique obstacle identity.
